== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The remaster prints twelve outside Defensive Shields where the original says up to twelve. It expressly applies the first-attempt exception to each player. Both retain four uses per game, the opposing draw or activation alternatives and the Thrown Back exception.
